title: 港股国庆后首日重挫，恒生指数跌2.6%创近6月最大单日跌幅，科网股全线下跌
summary: 10月2日港股恢复交易，恒生指数收报23972点，跌640点（跌幅2.6%），创3月以来最大单日跌幅；恒生科技指数跌2.26%。南向资金因内地国庆长假暂停，市场缺乏内资承接，美债收益率高企与美联储加息预期共同压制情绪，腾讯、美团、阿里均跌超2%，汇丰控股跌5.4%，友邦保险跌6%。
why: 港股大幅下跌叠加A股休市，反映外围宏观压力（高债息）对中国资产估值的冲击；sell put持仓须关注恒指支撑位，隐含波动率或短暂走高。

title: 美国9月非农新增仅2.9万，大幅低于预期9万，美联储10月加息概率骤降至17%
summary: 美国劳工统计局公布，9月非农就业新增2.9万，远低于市场预期9万且低于所有预测下限；失业率升至4.2%，前两月数据下修6万人。据CME FedWatch工具（2026年10月2日数据），美联储10月28日会议维持利率不变的概率升至83%（报告前为72%），加息概率从28%降至17%；美债收益率和美股期货均应声上涨。
why: 非农疲弱直接压低市场对10月加息的预期，支撑高估值科技股；sell put策略中期权溢价可能因加息预期降温而下降，关注波动率变化。CME FedWatch概率数据来源：2026年10月2日快照。

title: 10-year Treasury yield ticks higher to 5.28%, near 24-year high, despite softer jobs report
summary: The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield rose to approximately 5.28%, near its highest level since 2002, as the market digested elevated inflation concerns ahead of the October 28 Fed meeting. Yields had earlier surged to multi-year highs as surging fiscal deficits and strong economic expectations drove selling in government bonds; the September jobs miss provided only a brief respite.
why: 10Y收益率保持高位（超5.28%）是压制港股科网股和高估值美股的核心因素；收益率曲线变化对sell put策略的行权价选择和期权定价有直接影响。

title: Nike Q1 FY2027 earnings: Greater China revenue plunges 26%, full-year outlook cut to high-single-digit decline
summary: Nike reported Q1 FY2027 revenue of $11.21 billion (down 4% YoY, missed estimates of $11.35B), while EPS of $0.48 beat estimates of $0.44. Greater China sales fell 26% YoY, a further deterioration from prior quarters. Nike guided full-year FY2027 revenue to decline by a high-single-digit percentage and announced a restructuring plan with layoffs.
why: 耐克中国大区收入连续下滑26%是中国消费市场持续疲软的风向标，影响对美团、海底捞、蜜雪冰城等消费板块的宏观判断；Nike非持仓但是重要的中国消费先行指标。

title: Nvidia breaks to new all-time high above $236, market cap surpasses $5.7 trillion on AI demand and record $150B buyback
summary: Nvidia stock broke to a new all-time high above $236 on October 2, surpassing its prior May peak of $236.54 intraday, and market cap exceeded $5.7 trillion. The move followed Nvidia's late September announcement of a $150 billion increase to its share repurchase program (record authorization increase in history), lifting total remaining buyback authority to $235 billion through fiscal 2028. Morgan Stanley reinstated Nvidia as its top semiconductor pick.
why: 英伟达创新高是全球AI算力需求持续旺盛的信号，对SK海力士（HBM供应商）、腾讯（AI芯片采购方）等持仓均有正向提振；英伟达本身也在watchlist，ATH+史上最大回购是tier 1级别利多。

title: China's Tencent taps Oracle for 100,000 AI chips in $7B lease deal – largest ever overseas compute agreement
summary: Tencent signed a 5-year roughly $7 billion lease for ~100,000 advanced AI chips in Oracle's Southeast Asia data centers, with ~30% (~$2.1B) payable upfront. The chips cannot enter China under US export controls but can be accessed remotely. Described as Tencent's largest ever overseas lease agreement, the deal already weighed on Q2 free cash flow (negative RMB 13.8B) amid large AI-related prepayments. Capital expenditure in Q2 jumped 176% YoY to RMB 52.8B.
why: 腾讯以70亿美元锁定海外AI算力，是今年最大算力战略动作，显示腾讯AI推理/训练需求急剧扩大；对资本开支和自由现金流有负面影响，需关注期权定价中的不确定性。原始信源为FT，此处引用Seeking Alpha转载报道，待核实。

title: Citi: Xiaomi Group (01810.HK) delivered over 40,000 EVs in September, new monthly high in 2026; stock under pressure ahead of Q3 results
summary: Xiaomi Auto delivered more than 40,000 vehicles in September 2026, its highest monthly total this year. The newly launched Sky Nomad series (N70/N90) contributed over 10,000 units in its first month. Cumulative deliveries for the first 9 months reached at least 286,475 units, or ~52.1% of the 550,000 annual target. Citi maintains a target price of HKD 34 but notes the stock may remain under pressure ahead of Q3 earnings.
why: 小米汽车9月月交付首破4万辆里程碑，Sky Nomad新品放量是核心驱动；仍距全年550,000辆目标（约完成52%）有明显差距，后续季度交付压力增大；Citi目标价HKD 34说明机构估值仍偏谨慎，适合关注sell put行权价区间。
